_comment: Canonical record schema. android-app's Room entity and backend's Pydantic/SQLAlchemy models must all match this. If you change a field, update this file first and tell the team.

record.device_id: string — unique per installed app instance, generated on first launch
record.local_counter: integer — increments once per record captured on this device
record.captured_at: string — ISO 8601 timestamp, auto-captured, never user-entered
record.record_hash: string — sha256(record + previous_hash), computed on capture

design_rules: Records are append-only. No field is ever edited in place once captured — corrections are new records, not updates.
id is always device_id + local_counter. This is what makes merging two devices' record sets a simple set union with zero conflicts.
damage_assessment and claim fields are intentionally NOT part of this schema yet — that's a separate pipeline, scoped for later, not this week's build.
